snippet.title: Split Brain Samsara - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4370210/Split_Brain_Samsara/

You and your friend are locked in the same body! 

In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!
